name: Lumenfold Robotics

founders.name: Ana Velasquez
founders.bio: Previously led picking-systems engineering at a fictional 3PL, Northbay Logistics.

founders.name: Tomas Brandt
founders.bio: PhD in grasp planning; built the perception stack for the Lumenfold Picker.

facts.product: The Lumenfold Picker is a mobile arm that picks mixed-SKU totes at 600 picks per hour in pilot sites.
facts.customers: Three paid pilots with regional grocery distributors, all signed in 2026.
facts.funding: Raised a $3.1M seed round in 2024 led by a fictional fund, Granite Arc Capital.

news: Lumenfold opens a second pilot site in Columbus, Ohio.

name: Quillwave Bio

founders.name: Dr. Ifeoma Nwosu
founders.bio: Former computational biology lead at a fictional biotech, Helix Arbor.

founders.name: Raj Malhotra
founders.bio: Protein engineer with 40 published variants in enzyme stability.

facts.product: Quillwave designs heat-stable industrial enzymes with a generative model trained on 2 million assay results.
facts.customers: One signed development partnership with a fictional detergent maker, Brightfold Home.
facts.team: The company has 17 employees, 11 of them scientists.

news: Quillwave reports a 9-degree thermal stability gain in a partner enzyme.

name: Harborline Energy

founders.name: Grace Whitfield
founders.bio: Ran trading operations at a fictional power marketer, Lonestar Grid Partners.

founders.name: Kenji Arakawa
founders.bio: Built battery degradation models for utility-scale storage.

facts.product: Harborline's dispatch software schedules grid batteries against market prices and cell-degradation cost.
facts.customers: Software manages 410 MWh of storage across 7 sites.

news: Harborline adds degradation-aware bidding for two new Texas sites.

name: Tessellate Health

founders.name: Marcus Bell
founders.bio: Former clinical operations director at a fictional CRO, Meridian Trials.

founders.name: Sofia Lindqvist
founders.bio: Built EDC integrations for site-level trial data.

facts.product: Tessellate reconciles site EDC data with lab feeds and flags query backlogs before database lock.
facts.customers: Live with 4 mid-size sponsors across 31 active studies.

news: Tessellate passes a fictional third-party SOC 2 Type I audit.

name: Ferrowind Materials

founders.name: Elena Petrova
founders.bio: Metallurgist; previously ran a fictional pilot smelter, North Shore Alloys.

founders.name: Owen Castellanos
founders.bio: Scaled reverse-logistics programs for electronics recyclers.

facts.product: Ferrowind recovers neodymium magnets from retired wind turbines with a low-heat separation process.
facts.customers: Offtake letter of intent for 120 tonnes per year with a fictional motor maker, Arcwell Drives.
facts.funding: Raised a $9M seed round in 2024 including a state grant.

news: Ferrowind commissions its first 40-tonne pilot line.

name: Cindervale Security

founders.name: Hannah Adeyemi
founders.bio: Former incident-response lead at a fictional MSSP, Watchpoint.

founders.name: Luca Moretti
founders.bio: Built OAuth token-abuse detection for SaaS platforms.

facts.product: Cindervale detects abused OAuth grants and dormant service accounts across SaaS tenants.
facts.customers: 52 paying customers, mostly 200 to 2,000 employee companies.

news: Cindervale launches automatic revocation for stale OAuth grants.
